mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_sn, o.coupon_id, o.integration, o.member_id, ot.id ot_id, ot.product_name ot_product_name, ot.product_sku_id ot_product_sku_id, ot.product_sku_code ot_product_sku_code, ot.product_quantity ot_product_quantity FROM oms_order o LEFT JOIN oms_order_item ot ON o.id = ot.order_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId}

SELECT o.id, o.order_sn, o.coupon_id, o.integration, o.member_id, o.use_integration, o.order_type, o.promotion_info, ot.id ot_id, ot.product_name ot_product_name, ot.product_sku_id ot_product_sku_id, ot.product_sku_code ot_product_sku_code, ot.product_quantity ot_product_quantity FROM ( SELECT id, order_sn, coupon_id, integration, member_id, use_integration, order_type, promotion_info FROM oms_order WHERE status = 0 AND create_time < date_add(NOW(), INTERVAL -#{minute} MINUTE) ORDER BY create_time LIMIT #{limit} ) o LEFT JOIN oms_order_item ot ON o.id = ot.order_id
mapper.update: UPDATE oms_order SET status = 1, pay_type = #{payType}, payment_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 0 AND delete_status = 0
UPDATE oms_order SET status = 4 WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 0 AND delete_status = 0
UPDATE sms_seckill_sku SET seckill_stock = seckill_stock + #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
